# uptime

Print elapsed Linux system uptime.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/uptime -p
```

## Common options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->
<!-- Generated by tools/metadata from options.json. -->

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-p`, `--pretty` | Show elapsed uptime in words. |
| `--help` | Show help. |
| `--version` | Show the version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

## Notes

Reads the first value of /proc/uptime, including suspend time. Calendar boot time, load averages and logged-in user counts are outside this profile.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md) for the supported profile.
